comment: Same single book, responsibility rectangle and terminal facts as books_b1_only.json, but every split is taken in the opposite order (X-then-Y instead of Y-then-X). The root control 110 is retained on the root rectangle; the lower checked control (70 on A|P1 in the original) is omitted here, because an X-first tree has no cell at A|P1. Query semantics must be identical regardless of split order or of which ancestor carries a trusted control.
